searched: Built 2026-11-02. Meta: blobless clones of meta-llama/llama, meta-llama/llama3, meta-llama/llama-models, meta-llama/codellama, meta-llama/PurpleLlama and facebookresearch/cwm, with git log of every MODEL_CARD*.md (the GitHub API is not enabled in this session); Hugging Face model listings for the meta-llama, meta-models and facebook organisations (API, sorted by creation date); research.meta.ai blog index and every Muse post linked from it (Muse Spark 1.1, Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2, Muse Glimmer, Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Wonder, Muse Spark Open, 'Developing Capable Models Responsibly'); the arXiv record 2606.12429 (Muse Spark Safety & Preparedness Report); ai.meta.com answered HTTP 400 to every direct request. Microsoft: Hugging Face microsoft organisation searched for phi, Phi, MAI, Orca, bitnet, Fara, UserLM and Magma, with README and commit history of each Phi and MAI repository; microsoft.ai/models/ and microsoft.ai/news/ (read through a fetch tool; direct requests answer HTTP 403) and the MAI model pages and posts they link; card PDFs under microsoft.ai/pdf/. Web searches: 'Meta Muse Spark preparedness report 2026', 'Meta Superintelligence Labs model card safety report Advanced AI Scaling Framework', 'Microsoft AI MAI model card 2026', 'MAI-1-preview model card safety evaluation Frontier Governance Framework'. data/sources.json has no source for any Meta or Microsoft card (titles searched for 'Model Card', 'System Card', Llama, Phi, MAI). Population as read for this group: general-purpose generative language or multimodal-language models of Meta's LLaMA/Llama, Code Llama and Muse families and Microsoft's Phi and MAI families, plus Meta's CWM, which Meta assessed under its framework. Listed but outside: safety classifiers (Llama Guard, Prompt Guard), GUI-grounding models (Phi-Ground, Phi-Ground-Any), compression-research checkpoints (Phi-mini-MoE, Phi-tiny-MoE) and Orca 2. Not inventoried: format variants (ONNX, GGUF, FP8, quantised repositories), image, video, speech and embedding models (Muse Image, Muse Voice, MAI-Image, MAI-Voice, MAI-Transcribe, bitnet-embedding, VibeVoice), Meta FAIR research models (MobileLLM, MobileMoE and vision and 3D models) and Microsoft research models outside Phi and MAI (BitNet, Magma, UserLM, Fara). Hugging Face 'repository creation' and commit dates are repository metadata; a repository may have been private before release, so they are not release dates.
